scene: The machine chimes brightly and opens a glowing transit terminal bay behind it.
picture: Side view along a gleaming transit concourse floor. On the far left sits a waiting dragon maglev train with an open door. Left of centre stands the player on roller skates. In the centre hangs a glowing glass cable pod. On the far right is moored a solar-sail junk.
shown: a sleek golden-nosed dragon train waiting at the platform on the left
a spherical glass cloud pod hanging from overhead cables in the centre
a wooden solar-sail junk moored against the dock on the far right
